annotations.title: Check a web app manifest's screenshots

description: Use it when the user wants to know whether a web app's install dialog will show screenshots, or a manifest's screenshots checked. Checks the screenshots a web app manifest lists against Chrome's rules for its richer install dialog, without a browser: which ones a desktop and a phone would show, and what to fix. A failed check is a normal result, with the report as its summary. It takes a pwa/manifest-screenshots.json from take_screenshots as it is; when the check fails for want of screenshots, take_screenshots with pwa makes ones that pass. The screenshots playbook (makersmcp_playbook) has the whole job. (easyscreenshotkit 0.1.3, on this machine.)

manifest.description: The manifest's file or address, or the site's address, like https://linear.app, when its page links the manifest. A pwa/manifest-screenshots.json from take_screenshots is checked as it is.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result, counted from the start of the call, before returning a job_id to wait on. Some clients end a call after 60 or 240 seconds; 45 is safe in all of them.

name: check_pwa_screenshots

continued.description: True when this call continued the job an identical call started, instead of starting another.

docs.description: The notes the text shows, and where each one is.

expires_at.description: When the download links stop working.

url.description: Where to download the file, when the job ran on a server.
